# Amazon.co.uk
> Amazon.co.uk is Amazon’s UK marketplace for shopping, digital content, subscriptions, customer support, and seller services.

Amazon.co.uk combines retail shopping, Prime membership benefits, digital media, device ecosystems, and merchant tools for UK customers and businesses.

## Shopping & Discovery
- [Amazon.co.uk Homepage](https://www.amazon.co.uk/): Main UK storefront for browsing products, departments, and promotions.
- [Best Sellers](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/bestsellers): Most popular products across major categories and departments.
- [Hot New Releases](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/new-releases): Recently launched products gaining popularity across categories.
- [Movers and Shakers](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/movers-and-shakers): Products with the biggest recent sales rank gains.
- [Today's Deals](https://www.amazon.co.uk/deals): Time-limited discounts, featured offers, and deal collections.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gift-cards): Buy, send, and manage Amazon.co.uk gift cards.
- [Browsing History](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/history): Review recently viewed products and continue shopping.

## Departments & Category Stores
- [Books](https://www.amazon.co.uk/books-used-books-textbooks/b/): Books, textbooks, and reading formats across genres.
- [Kindle Store](https://www.amazon.co.uk/Kindle-eBooks/b/): Kindle ebooks, digital reading deals, and featured titles.
- [Electronics & Photo](https://www.amazon.co.uk/electronics-camera-photo/b/): Consumer electronics, cameras, accessories, and devices.
- [Computers & Accessories](https://www.amazon.co.uk/computers-accessories/b/): Laptops, components, peripherals, and networking products.
- [Home & Kitchen](https://www.amazon.co.uk/home-kitchen/b/): Furniture, cookware, appliances, and household essentials.
- [Fashion](https://www.amazon.co.uk/fashion/b/): Clothing, shoes, jewelry, watches, and accessories.
- [Toys & Games](https://www.amazon.co.uk/toys/b/): Toys, games, collectibles, and children’s products.
- [Grocery](https://www.amazon.co.uk/grocery-food-drinks/b/): Pantry staples, beverages, snacks, and household grocery items.

## Prime & Membership
- [Amazon Prime](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime): Prime membership overview, pricing, and included benefits.
- [Prime Video](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/video/storefront): Streaming movies, series, channels, and live sports.
- [Prime Gaming](https://www.amazon.co.uk/primegaming): Gaming benefits, free content, and member offers.
- [Amazon Music Prime](https://www.amazon.co.uk/music/prime): Music streaming included with Prime membership.
- [Prime Try Before You Buy](https://www.amazon.co.uk/prime-wardrobe): Try eligible fashion items before being charged.
- [Amazon Family](https://www.amazon.co.uk/family): Family-focused offers and benefits for eligible customers.

## Digital Content & Devices
- [Amazon Music](https://www.amazon.co.uk/music): Music streaming, playlists, stations, and subscriptions.
- [Audible](https://www.amazon.co.uk/audible): Audiobooks, podcasts, and spoken-word subscriptions.
- [Kindle E-readers & Books](https://www.amazon.co.uk/kindle-dbs/hz/signup): Kindle services and digital reading ecosystem entry point.
- [Appstore for Android](https://www.amazon.co.uk/mobile-apps/b/): Android apps, games, and digital downloads.
- [Fire TV](https://www.amazon.co.uk/firetv): Fire TV streaming devices and entertainment features.
- [Alexa](https://www.amazon.co.uk/alexa): Alexa-enabled devices, voice assistant features, and smart home integrations.
- [Ring](https://www.amazon.co.uk/stores/Ring/page/): Ring smart security devices and home monitoring products.

## Customer Account & Orders
- [Your Account](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/css/homepage.html): Central hub for account settings, orders, and preferences.
- [Your Orders](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/css/order-history): View, track, return, and manage past orders.
- [Login & Security](https://www.amazon.co.uk/a/your-account/login-and-security): Manage password, passkeys, and account security settings.
- [Your Addresses](https://www.amazon.co.uk/a/addresses): Add and manage delivery addresses.
- [Your Payments](https://www.amazon.co.uk/cpe/yourpayments/wallet): Manage cards, bank accounts, and payment methods.
- [Your Lists](https://www.amazon.co.uk/hz/wishlist/ls): Access wish lists and saved item collections.
- [Your Subscribe & Save Items](https://www.amazon.co.uk/auto-deliveries): Manage recurring deliveries and subscription products.

## Help, Returns & Support
- [Customer Service](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/help/customer/display.html): Main help hub for orders, payments, devices, and policies.
- [Returns Centre](https://www.amazon.co.uk/returns): Start and manage product returns and replacements.
- [Track Your Package](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GCU8BWGTQNJKQEBS): Help for package tracking and delivery updates.
- [Delivery Rates and Policies](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=G26L6NHEDGERVR8W): Shipping options, charges, and delivery policy details.
- [About Our Returns Policies](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=GKM69DUUYKQWKWX7): Return eligibility windows and refund policy information.
- [Product Safety Alerts and Recalls](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=G201889520): Safety notices, recalls, and related customer guidance.

## Selling on Amazon
- [Sell on Amazon](https://sell.amazon.co.uk/): Overview of selling programs and merchant onboarding.
- [Seller Central](https://sellercentral.amazon.co.uk/): Seller account management for listings, orders, and performance.
- [Fulfilment by Amazon](https://sell.amazon.co.uk/fulfilment-by-amazon): FBA service overview for storage, packing, and delivery.
- [Amazon Brand Registry](https://brandservices.amazon.co.uk/): Brand protection and intellectual property tools for sellers.
- [Amazon Handmade](https://sell.amazon.co.uk/programmes/handmade): Marketplace program for approved artisan sellers.
- [Amazon Business Seller](https://sell.amazon.co.uk/programmes/amazon-business): Tools for reaching business customers on Amazon.
- [Seller University](https://sell.amazon.co.uk/learn): Educational resources and guides for sellers.

## Business & Professional Services
- [Amazon Business](https://www.amazon.co.uk/business): Business purchasing, invoicing, and procurement features.
- [Business Prime](https://www.amazon.co.uk/businessprime): Membership benefits designed for business buying teams.
- [Amazon Tax Exemption Program](https://www.amazon.co.uk/b2b/info/vat): VAT-related business purchasing and tax information.
- [Amazon Business Help](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=202074690): Support information for Amazon Business customers.

## Programs, Trade-In & Sustainability
- [Amazon Trade-In](https://www.amazon.co.uk/l/918722031): Trade in eligible devices and electronics for credit.
- [Amazon Second Chance](https://www.amazon.co.uk/secondchance): Recycling, trade-in, and product lifecycle information.
- [Amazon Warehouse](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonwarehouse): Pre-owned, used, and open-box product deals.
- [Amazon Renewed](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonrenewed): Professionally inspected refurbished products with guarantees.
- [Luxury Stores](https://www.amazon.co.uk/luxurystores): Curated premium fashion and beauty shopping experience.

## About, Policies & Legal
- [About Amazon](https://www.amazon.co.uk/b?node=560798): Corporate information, company background, and site information.
- [Conditions of Use & Sale](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201909000): Terms governing use of Amazon.co.uk and purchases.
- [Privacy Notice](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201909010): How Amazon collects, uses, and protects personal data.
- [Cookies Notice](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201890250): Information about cookies and related choices.
- [Interest-Based Ads Notice](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=201909150): Advertising personalization practices and opt-out information.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://www.amazon.co.uk/gp/help/customer/display.html?nodeId=G7P5SPCQ3QZD8QXG): Accessibility information for Amazon services and experiences.
